data.title: Added US pressure on Iran may lead to Iraqi militias lashing out | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Iran-backed militias in Iraq have played a central role in expanding Tehran’s influence in the country, particularly through their involvement in the Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF).
data.keywords: Iran,Iraq,Terrorism,iran iraq,Kurdistan,Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps,Kataib Hezbollah,Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF),Al-Zaidi
